title: City view
description: You look out over San Vesper as it comes awake by slow degrees. In the distance, the towers of Civic Crown catch the first pale gold of dawn, their edges softened by bay fog and the city's lingering smog. From here, the skyline feels strangely remote: clean lines, cold light, a promise that belongs to someone else. Morning spills through the bare window glass without obstruction, and for a moment the city looks almost gentle, though never quite harmless.
